decisionSummary: The Aug 19 dev-publish v0.22.1/version-23 source is canonical. It retains the current runtime contract and deterministic package controls while adding a source test that binds Calendar identity across metadata, package definition, Makefile, and capability manifest and rejects Contacts contamination. The preserved v19 connection snapshot was compared function-by-function: the selected source retains every prior connection-capability function and adds newer event/contact behavior. Main and develop are an April pre-greenfield tree; remaining heads are merged predecessors or historical artifact/release lines.
